verifier_prompt: After the PR is created, the /cass:pr command must spawn the qa agent in --verify-pr mode. Evidence of this is: (1) the output mentions qa verification or a QA Verification report, OR (2) the qa agent is explicitly spawned with --verify-pr in the session. The qa agent must attempt to run the suite and report the result (pass, fail, or error — any outcome is acceptable; the verifier checks that the attempt was made, not that jest is installed). Fail if: no PR is created, or the qa agent is never spawned in verify-pr mode.
